# Psalm 41 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** For-the-choirmaster. A-psalm of-David.

**2** Blessed [is] the-one-who-considers the-poor; in-the-day of-evil YHWH delivers-him.

**3** YHWH preserves-him and-keeps-him-alive; he-is-called blessed in-the-land. And-do-not give-him to-the-desire of-his-enemies.

**4** YHWH sustains-him on-the-bed of-illness; all his-bed You-transform in-his-sickness.

**5** I said, 'YHWH, be-gracious to-me; heal my-soul, for I-have-sinned against-You.'

**6** My-enemies speak evil of-me: 'When will-he-die and-his-name perish?'

**7** And-if he-comes to-see [me], emptiness he-speaks; his-heart gathers iniquity to-itself; he-goes outside, he-tells [it].

**8** Together they-whisper against-me, all those-hating-me; against-me they-devise harm for-me:

**9** 'A-thing of-Belial is-poured-out on-him, and-[now] that he-has-lain-down, he-will-not rise again.'

**10** Even the-man of-my-peace in-whom I-trusted, the-one-eating my-bread, has-magnified [his] heel against-me.

**11** But-You, YHWH, be-gracious to-me and-raise-me-up, that-I-may repay-them.

**12** By-this I-know that You-delight in-me: that my-enemy does-not shout-in-triumph over-me.

**13** And-as-for-me, in-my-integrity You-uphold-me, and-You-set-me before-Your-face forever.

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **41:10**: Jesus quotes this verse at the Last Supper (John 13:18) — 'the one eating my bread has lifted his heel against me' — identifying Judas as the betrayer.

— EMET
